stem: Source-water EC is noticeably higher than its established baseline before fertilizer is added. What should be done first?
choices: Reduce irrigation frequency across the crop because higher source EC indicates excessive root-zone moisture
Increase fertilizer concentration so the final solution maintains the previous nutrient-to-water proportion
Verify the source-water EC and compare it with prior source records before changing the nutrient program
Adjust final solution pH first because pH correction will compensate for the changed starting ionic load
rationale: A source-water EC change can alter the starting ionic load. The strongest first step is to verify the measurement and source change before modifying the nutrient program.
